name: bitwarden-eval-tools
description: Tools for evaluating Bitwarden skills. `running-trigger-evals` measures whether a skill fires on the right phrasings, in installed or isolated mode, with reliability-aware reporting and an opt-in baseline regression check. `running-behavioral-evals` measures whether it changes the work product, through blind paired runs graded against verified ground truth, and carries the ablation-accretion recipe for trimming a skill to its load-bearing core.
